m1.typescript: m1 the eight sections are present in order and filled

e1.typescript: e1 the decision statement carries the volume the latency the error cost and the accountable role

e2.typescript: e2 the options include a recommended one that is the cheapest to meet the service levels and a reason for each rejection

e3.typescript: e3 the break even accuracy is 98 percent and the recommendation states the cost

e4.typescript: e4 each service level has a target within the case limits and a named owner

e5.typescript: e5 segments are listed by error cost and handled by the break even

e6.typescript: e6 the pilot to scale table has four assumptions each with a test and a stop trigger with a number

e7.typescript: e7 the hand off names an owner a runbook a rollback and monitors

e8.typescript: e8 the sponsor summary has at most 80 words and states the cost and the decision and no file holds personal data

wrong-section-renamed.defect: renames a required section, so the record no longer has its eight sections

wrong-todo-left.defect: leaves a TODO in the record

wrong-no-role.defect: does not name the role accountable for each credit

wrong-no-error-cost.defect: does not give the cost of a wrong credit or of a check

wrong-cheapest-not-recommended.defect: recommends an option that is not the cheapest one that meets the service levels

wrong-rejection-no-reason.defect: rejects an option with a reason of two words

wrong-breakeven-97.defect: states a break-even accuracy of 97 percent for costs that give 98

wrong-latency-2500.defect: promises a latency of 2500 ms against a limit of 2000

wrong-availability-99.defect: promises an availability of 99.0 percent against a floor of 99.5

wrong-sla-no-owner.defect: gives a service level the owner TBD

wrong-status-reviewed.defect: sends a segment at the break-even accuracy to a person

wrong-status-97-auto.defect: lets a segment below the break-even accuracy go out unreviewed

wrong-segment-order.defect: lists the cheapest segment before a costlier one

wrong-shape-unnamed.defect: describes a failure shape in a word that names no shape

wrong-pilot-three.defect: names three assumptions of the pilot and not four

wrong-trigger-no-number.defect: gives a stop trigger with no number in it

wrong-no-runbook.defect: does not say who owns a runbook

wrong-no-rollback.defect: has no rollback and no previous model kept

wrong-summary-81-words.defect: writes a sponsor summary of 81 words

wrong-summary-no-cost.defect: leaves the monthly cost out of the sponsor summary

wrong-summary-no-decision.defect: does not ask the sponsor for a decision

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the record
